full_prompt_en: A vertical modern oil landscape shows a quiet riverside settlement beneath immense sunlit clouds. Along the left and middle shore, pale blue and cream houses with muted red tile roofs sit among umbrella pines and tall, dark cypress trees. The trees rise in several distinct shapes: flat green canopies stretch horizontally near the lower half, while narrow almost black spires cut upward against the bright sky. Behind them, softer mint-green tree columns and a small white house climb the slope. The lower portion of the composition is still water, reflecting roofs, trunks, foliage, and patches of light as slightly broken vertical color bands. Beyond the near shore, the river or lake disappears into a pale blue haze at the right. Above the village, huge cream and gray cloud towers billow across a flat powder-blue sky, filling most of the upper frame. The painterly treatment simplifies buildings into clear rectangular planes and vegetation into controlled color masses, with visible short strokes and some rough texture inside the shapes. The clouds are built from thicker, softer clustered marks that carry cool gray shadow and warm white highlights. Strong daylight brightens the facades and cloud edges, while cypress and water shadows stay deep blue-green. The palette is bright yet tempered: sky blue, cream, mint, olive, dark teal, red-brown, and gray. The composition balances the vertical rhythm of cypresses and cloud plumes with the horizontal calm of the shoreline and water. It feels clear, decorative, and tranquil, with a recognizable place organized into a pattern of light, dark, and reflection.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅竖向现代油画风景表现巨大受光云团下安静的河畔聚落。左侧及中央岸边，浅蓝与奶油房屋带暗红瓦顶，坐落于伞松与高深柏树之间。树形成几种清楚形态：扁平绿树冠在下半部水平展开，狭窄近黑树尖则向上切入明亮天空。其后，更柔的薄荷绿树柱与一座小白屋沿坡上升。构图下方是平静水面，屋顶、树干、叶和光片映成略断裂的竖色带。近岸之外，河或湖在右侧消入浅蓝雾。村庄上方，巨大奶油与灰云塔横跨平坦粉蓝天空，填满大部分上方画幅。绘画处理把房子简化成清楚矩形平面，把植被简化为受控色块，形状内部有可见短笔和些许粗纹。云由更厚、更柔的聚簇笔痕建成，带冷灰阴影与暖白高光。强日光照亮立面与云边，柏树和水影保持深蓝绿。配色明亮却被调和：天蓝、奶油、薄荷、橄榄、深青、红褐与灰。构图以柏树和云柱的竖向节奏平衡岸线与水面的水平安静。画面清澈、有装饰性且宁静，把可辨地点整理成明、暗与倒影的图案。
style_prompt_en: Modern oil landscape painting simplifies a view into clear architectural planes, rounded green masses, narrow dark verticals, and broad cloud volumes. Powder blue and cream occupy large bright areas, balanced by mint, olive, deep teal, small red-brown accents, and cool gray shadow. Short visible brush marks and slightly rough pigment give buildings and vegetation a tactile edge; softer thick clusters model the clouds. Strong daylight creates bright exposed faces and luminous white tops, while dark blue-green forms stay solid and graphic. A calm horizontal reflective band below repeats the upright masses as broken vertical strokes. Depth is readable through smaller, paler shapes receding into blue haze, but the scene remains deliberately patterned. The rhythm alternates tall spires, flat canopy layers, rectangular blocks, and swelling sky forms, making the composition serene yet visually active.
style_prompt_zh: 现代油画风景把视域简化成清晰建筑平面、圆浑绿块、狭窄暗竖形与宽阔云体。粉蓝与奶油占据大片亮域，薄荷、橄榄、深青、少量红褐和冷灰影予以平衡。可见短笔痕和略粗颜料让建筑与植被有可触边缘；更柔更厚的聚簇笔痕塑造云。强日光形成明亮外露面与发光白顶，深蓝绿形体保持结实而图形化。下方平静水平反光带把竖向体量重复成断续竖笔。较小较浅形状退入蓝雾使深度可读，但场景仍刻意图案化。节奏在高尖形、平树冠层、矩形块和膨胀天空形之间交替，使构图宁静却视觉活跃。
theme_en: A sunlit riverside village and tall cypresses reflected below towering clouds
theme_zh: 河畔村屋与高柏在巨大云团下映入平静水面
name: Yves Brayer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
